title: Source lock — xw-platform import commits
description: Locks the exact source commits AND their trees to import into xw-platform. importCommit + importTreeSha values read from real remote main SHAs after PR #17 (M0 amendment) and PR #16 (F0 source-only gate) merged. Each import receipt MUST verify receipt.originalCommit == sourceLock.<repo>.importCommit AND receipt.originalTreeSha == sourceLock.<repo>.importTreeSha.
